name: cljs-thread
description: cljs-thread: zero-config Web Worker / worker_threads for ClojureScript, with EVE shared-memory persistent data structures

scripts.test:browser: npx shadow-cljs compile browser-test && npx playwright test test/e2e/cljs-tests.spec.js
scripts.test:integration: npx shadow-cljs compile integration-sw integration && npx playwright test test/e2e/integration.spec.js
scripts.test:sw-fallback: npx shadow-cljs compile sw-fallback-sw sw-fallback-browser && npx playwright test --config test/e2e/playwright-sw-fallback.config.js
scripts.test:all: npx shadow-cljs compile node-test browser-test integration-sw integration sw-fallback-sw sw-fallback-browser && npx playwright test
